text:
Tina: Morning — async check-in. What I did: rolled the kv-evict tuning canary to 10% and collected a few tail-latency traces. Blockers: we need a small memory bump for the prod pool (ticket INF-342) before full rollout. Today: watching canary, writing notes for postmortem, pinging @Matt for quota bump.

Matt: I see the tail as well, digging into kernel sched and GPU memory fragmentation. I can queue the pool bump now if we want — ETA 15m.

Reza: Merged batching fix (PR #482). CI green, stress tests look good. No blockers from my side, will watch the batching queue metrics.

Olivia: Oncall saw three eviction pages overnight, correlating with autoscaler churn. Left preliminary notes in the runbook. Adding this alert query to the thread: ```sum(increase(kv_evictions_total[10m])) by (instance) > 0``` — it's noisy but helped find the spike.

Sophie: Quick CR ping @Reza on PR #482 — one tiny nit about a log message, otherwise LGTM.

pagerbot: 2 pages in the last 12h: HOST-evict-high (02:13), Batcher-504 (05:47). Escalation to oncall at 03:12.

Tina: Thanks — I linked INF-342 to the canary dashboard and added perf graphs: https://grafana.company/redwood/d/pool/kvevict. :thumbsup:

Matt: Pool bump queued and will deploy in ~15m, I'll post a follow-up when done.

Reza: PR #482 approved and will roll to canary after Matt's deploy.

Olivia: I'll add a short play in the runbook to temporarily disable aggressive warmup if we see sustained eviction spikes.

Tina: Great. Last question — who is oncall tomorrow morning?

Sophie: I'm on morning oncall, Olivia covering the night shift.

Tina: Perfect. If anyone sees regression after the bump, ping here or @pager for urgent pages.

Matt: Update: bump deployed, monitoring now.

Reza: Noted — rolling canary of batching fix started.

Olivia: I'll check runbook notes and tidy after shifts.

Sophie: Thanks all, will monitor handover.
